description: This Java source file defines a Tracking class that manages activity lifecycle events within an Android application, including inner classes for tracking tasks and activities, with methods for handling activity resume and destruction, as well as maintaining activity order and task membership.

classes.name: Tracking
classes.description: Main class providing tracking of activities and tasks lifecycle within the app, with inner classes for detailed task and activity management.

classes.name: Tracking.Tracker
classes.description: Inner class responsible for maintaining current tasks and activities, handling lifecycle events, and notifying listeners.

classes.name: Tracking.Task
classes.description: Inner class representing a task with an identifier and a list of activities, including methods for adding/removing activities and copying for UI display.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles an activity being resumed, updates task order and activity state.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles an activity being destroyed, removing it from its task and possibly removing the task if empty.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to be notified when the task list changes.
